specification_compliance: Spec §7 explicitly accepts the get_collection on_home pass-through but does not mention add_to_collection, which also passes on_home through via the raw POST /items response.
potential_unspecified_behavior: MCP add_to_collection output now includes on_home; not described in spec §7 or the touch points.
